purpose: Persist authenticated reader sessions and one-time per-user chapter completion milestones after the Imperial XP ledger foundation.
constraints: Session identity is stored only as a SHA-256 token hash; raw bearer tokens are never persisted.
A user may have only one active session per chapter.
Completion requires server-maintained active time and at least 90 percent maximum reported chapter progress.
The database rejects completion records that do not match a qualified completed session.
A user can complete a given chapter only once.
This migration creates no XP awards and trusts no client-supplied XP delta.
Production D1 execution requires separate release approval.
